basis: ADR-029 Access in response body and Authorization Bearer only

public API contract ApiError/problem codes and AbortSignal
contract: Every API request snapshots the current Bearer and privacy epoch; guests omit Authorization

Mutation 401/503 never auto retries or falls back to guest
Existing AbortSignal is forwarded; abort errors are not retried
